$comment: REQ-HUN-010, DL-007. Every modifier here is a WEIGHT. None is a filter. Values are clamped by balance/personality.json before use, so a personality can break a near-tie but never overturn Guild Policy.

personalities.name: Cautious
personalities.description: Prefers a survivable outcome over a decisive one. Retreats early, heals early.

personalities.name: Reckless
personalities.description: Commits hard and worries later. Excellent when it works, expensive when it does not.

personalities.name: Stoic
personalities.description: Unmoved by circumstance. Consistent performance regardless of morale.

personalities.name: Protective
personalities.description: Weighs ally safety above personal efficiency. Attempts rescues others would decline.

personalities.name: Methodical
personalities.description: Optimises resource use and setup over immediate output. Slow starts, strong finishes.

personalities.name: Opportunist
personalities.description: Waits for openings and spends everything when one appears.
